new_categories.label: treatment_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: Dry-cargo hold fumigation or pest-control treatment can be represented as a delivered protective service-state distinct from general cleanliness or washdown readiness.

new_categories.label: treatment_input_support_confidence
new_categories.memory: Availability of the bounded treatment input/support needed for the service can be represented without retaining agent identity, concentration, dose or preparation details.

new_categories.label: hold_zone_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Treatment scope can be bounded to a hold or zone without retaining exact application points, distribution layouts or cargo-specific treatment plans.

new_categories.label: containment_boundary_confidence
new_categories.memory: Containment/boundary confidence is distinct from treatment delivery and can degrade independently without retaining sealing actions, closure lineups or detailed barrier arrangements.

new_categories.label: treatment_distribution_coverage_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric confidence that treatment reaches the intended bounded scope can be represented without agent concentration, dosage, placement or distribution instructions.

new_categories.label: support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Closure, monitoring, ventilation, power or other support dependencies can be represented as aggregate confidence without retaining operating lineups or settings.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_treatment_effect_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric confidence that the intended pest-control treatment effect is being delivered can be retained without exact readings, target values or exposure requirements.

new_categories.label: monitoring_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring/verification confidence is distinct from treatment delivery, containment and scope and can degrade without retaining gas readings, sampling locations, thresholds or test methods.

new_categories.label: post_treatment_release_confidence
new_categories.memory: Post-treatment release/clearance can be represented only as a bounded confidence state, separate from exact ventilation, entry or measurement criteria and procedures.

new_categories.label: treatment_service_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: The treatment service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to treatment service, input/support, hold/zone scope, containment, monitoring/verification or post-treatment release confidence.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Infestation concern, cargo-condition uncertainty, hold restriction, terminal acceptance issues, rework or schedule effects do not prove a treatment, containment, support, monitoring or scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_treatment_restoration
new_categories.memory: Treatment-service correction, support recovery, containment confidence, verification, release confidence and hold return-to-service can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: cleanliness_vs_pest_control_treatment
useful_refinements.memory: P109 cleanliness/readiness does not establish fumigation or pest-control treatment-service readiness.

useful_refinements.label: washdown_vs_fumigation_treatment
useful_refinements.memory: P117 delivered cleaning/washdown service is distinct from fumigation/pest-control treatment even when both support cargo preparation.

useful_refinements.label: ventilation_drying_support_vs_treatment_service
useful_refinements.memory: P089 ventilation and P116 drying can support treatment or later restoration but do not establish the pest-control treatment service itself.

useful_refinements.label: generic_equipment_lifecycle_vs_delivered_treatment_service
useful_refinements.memory: P067 generic lifecycle/support semantics do not establish delivered fumigation/pest-control treatment readiness.

duplicates.label: generic_scope_support_monitoring_verification_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic bounded scope, support dependency and monitoring/verification mechanics repeat prior shipboard service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage restoration are already campaign-wide.

exact containment closure lineups, monitoring locations, gas readings, thresholds, ventilation or entry/release criteria, tests and acceptance values
exact agent handling, application, exposure control, monitoring, ventilation, re-entry, cargo handling, troubleshooting, shutdown, isolation or emergency procedures

negative_space: exact treatment agents, concentration, dose, quantity, exposure duration, application/distribution arrangement and current configuration
exact containment closures, monitoring points, gas readings, thresholds, ventilation/entry/release criteria, test values and acceptance limits
exact agent handling, application, exposure control, monitoring, ventilation, re-entry, cargo handling, troubleshooting, shutdown, isolation or emergency procedures
named contractors, providers, ports, yards, cargo incidents, exposure events, claims, findings, current readiness and private/regional/non-English lineages
stop_reason: The bounded fumigation/pest-control service-state questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact agents, concentration/dose, exposure timing, gas measurements, ventilation/entry criteria, operating procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo hold fumigation/pest-control treatment-service orientation and source-discovery output; not agent selection, application, exposure control, ventilation, entry or emergency guidance and not proof of any exact agent, concentration, dose, threshold, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
